---
title: Python execution controls
fig-width: 4
fig-height: 3
execute:
  echo: false
  error: true
---

```{python}
#| include: false
#| echo: true
#| output: true
setup_value = 7
print("PY_HIDDEN_SETUP")
```

```{python}
print("PY_SETUP_VALUE", setup_value)
```

```{python}
#| warning: false
import warnings, sys
warnings.warn("PY_HIDDEN_WARNING")
sys.stderr.write("PY_HIDDEN_STDERR\n")
print("PY_VISIBLE_STDOUT")
```

```{python}
warnings.warn("PY_VISIBLE_WARNING")
sys.stderr.write("PY_VISIBLE_STDERR\n")
```

```{python}
#| output: false
warnings.warn("PY_WARNING_WITHOUT_OUTPUT")
print("PY_HIDDEN_RESULT")
```

```{python}
raise ValueError("PY_VISIBLE_ERROR")
```

```{python}
print("PY_AFTER_ALLOWED_ERROR")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
raise ValueError("PY_HIDDEN_ERROR")
```

See @fig-python-controls.

```{python}
#| label: fig-python-controls
#| fig-cap: Python controlled plot
#| fig-alt: A line rising from one to three
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("PY_FIG_SIZE", *(int(n) for n in plt.rcParams["figure.figsize"]))
plt.plot([1, 2], [1, 3]);
```

```{python}
"PY_SUPPRESSED_VALUE"; # A final semicolon suppresses expression display.
```
